messages:
maria: Heads-up — apiserver 503s in eu-central-1 starting ~6789012345. Spike coincided with a large Dedicated GPU pool onboarding (batch attach). Seeing fd counts climb and lots of ephemeral connections. anyone oncall?
ops-bot: alert: apiserver 5xx rate 120/min, etcd leader latency 350ms, conntrack used 98% (eu-central-1).
samir: I'm looking. Can you paste apiserver logs?
maria: quick tail: ```
apiserver: 2026-03-20T12:03:10Z E030 12:03:10.123 listen.go:103] accept tcp 0.0.0.0:6443: accept4: too many open files
apiserver: 2026-03-20T12:03:11Z E030 12:03:11.456 resthandler.go:89] request failed: context deadline exceeded
etcd: 2026-03-20T12:03:12Z WAL sync took 340ms, pending snapshots
controller-manager: leader election lost: heartbeat timeout
```
jordan: that WAL sync line is worrying — I bet NVMe iops spiked during image pulls for the GPU nodes and snapshot writes blocked. also conntrack exhaustion from kube-proxy NAT + bursty kubelet connections is likely causing apiserver accept backlog.
kai: Confirmed conntrack bump on the NAT gateway metrics. We saw ephemeral ports exhausted when ~1500 nodes started attaching across that AZ in a 3-minute window.
samir: Workplan: 1) throttle attach rollouts (pause onboarding), 2) increase apiserver fd limit and /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_max temporarily, 3) reduce kubelet reporting frequency on new nodes (--node-status-update-frequency=20s) and enable keepalive coalescing where possible.
maria: Doing (1) now — paused the onboarding job. Applying fd limit change to apiserver pod.
jordan: Also add a short-term controller-manager leader election grace increase to avoid flapping (leaseDuration + renewDeadline). That will lower churn while we stabilize.
samir: I pushed conntrack bump on NAT (temporarily +30%). Watch CPU on NAT.
kai: NAT CPU climbed but stable for now. apiserver 5xx dropped to 20/min. etcd leader latency down to ~80ms.
maria: After throttling attach rate to 50 nodes/min the FD curve flattened. Rolling restart of kube-proxy on a sample of new nodes reduced conn reuse by half.
jordan: Longer term items: - avoid concurrent big attaches in same region (rate limiter in provisioner), - add backpressure in dedicated onboarding path, - add prober that simulates burst attach to control plane to catch regressions.
samir: Filing follow-up ticket and tagging infra-provisioning + networking. Also capture a small reproducer for QA.
maria: Thanks all. Keeping the pause until the onboarding job is reworked. Will update incident doc. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident-note: mitigation applied — onboarding paused, apiserver fd limit increased, conntrack increased. Monitoring alerting adjusted.
